name: Open Sub-Account for Member
description: Logs into the Corevance Core Banking Admin app, searches for a member by ID, opens a new sub-account (Savings/Money Market/CD) with an initial deposit, and captures the confirmation reference number, new account number, and opening balance.

member_id.description: Numeric member identifier to search for and open the sub-account under

account_type.description: Sub-account type to open: Savings, Money Market, or Certificate of Deposit

initial_deposit.description: Initial deposit amount for the new sub-account (minimum $25.00)

reference_number.description: Confirmation reference number for the sub-account opening request

opening_balance.description: Confirmed opening balance shown on the confirmation screen

business_outcomes.message: No member exists with the given member ID

steps.intent: Navigate to Open Sub-Account form for this member
Select the account type in the dropdown

business_outcomes.message: The initial deposit is below the minimum required opening deposit of $25.00

steps.intent: Extract the newly created account number
